# platform.FeatureFlagDefinition

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A feature flag declared in the code registry, with owner, reason, kind and expiry.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.FeatureFlagDefinition` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `platform.flag.manage` |

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the flag was introduced (UTC). |  |
| `default` | yes | `none` | Value when no environment or tenant value is set. |  |
